summary: Facepalm: Searches found few fresh facepalm stories. One candidate, the 11 House Democrats who missed the Hegseth impeachment vote, has two accepted sources. The ones that came close are listed under passed. No facepalm story met the standard; nothing published. The verified genius story is on the bench for a later day.
